mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 755,000 units signals strong residential construction demand, correlating with elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.15% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 5 trading days following FEDFUNDS falling below 0.15%, SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE indicates central bank response to economic weakness, reducing recession risk and triggering market rallies, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS) signals improving job market conditions that reduce recession risk and boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 97.0 indicates robust manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, correlating with rising earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 760,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand for durable goods, preceding corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where HOUST > 760.0, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, typically causing market corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 133,500 thousand signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.
